theater: 阿爾及爾灣與西地中海

battle.name: 第二次巴巴利戰爭
battle.theater: 阿爾及爾灣與西地中海
battle.brief: 一八一五年春，復國的西班牙波旁王朝以七十四門砲的旗艦「皇家菲利普號」遠征阿爾及爾，要求收回奧蘭與阿爾及爾的西班牙據城，並追討私掠與奴役基督徒的舊賬。攻城屢挫，戰事在阿爾及爾灣拖成拉鋸，最後一八一六年以西軍保住奧蘭、德伊守住阿爾及爾了結。火繩槍銃此時已退居民兵與私掠船的守備兵器。

kit.name: 火繩槍銃
kit.history: 比步槍輕的長槍。西班牙人帶著它上船，也帶著它進了美洲。

countries: 一八一五年到一八一六年開打的是恢復王位的西班牙王國與阿爾及爾攝政（德伊國）之間的一場戰爭，形式上是西班牙要收回北非失地與商路特權，骨子裡是歐洲國家第一次攔截巴巴利私掠國度。西班牙一方是費迪南德七世的波旁王朝：全國分成軍隊與省級民兵兩套序列，遠征阿爾及爾的部隊由王室的直屬步兵、騎兵與海軍陸戰隊組成，配屬攻城砲與工程兵，後方以加的斯為基地，補給靠海運維持。海軍方面派出地中海分遣艦隊，旗艦為七十四門砲的「皇家菲利普號」，另有數艘巡防艦、護衛艦與小型砲艦，負責封鎖阿爾及爾港、掩護登陸與運糧。阿爾及爾一方名義上是奧斯曼蘇丹的屬地，實際由德伊哈吉·阿里獨立執政，首都阿爾及爾的城防由法籍工程師與本地工匠修築，軍隊核心是受德伊直接指揮的土耳其裔「沙基」野戰兵與城防砲兵，另有柏柏爾與阿拉伯部族提供的非正規民兵，以及由私掠船船員組成的「私掠共和國」艦隊。突尼斯與的黎波里的另外兩個巴巴利攝政區名義上站在德伊一邊，但直接派兵有限。英國雖未與西班牙正式宣戰，卻以海上封鎖、軍火與外交三重角色介入，成為雙方之間的實際仲裁者。
countriesEn: Spanning 1815 to 1816, this was a war between the restored Bourbon monarchy of Spain and the Regency of Algiers: on the surface a Spanish bid to recover lost North African positions and commercial privileges, but in substance the first coordinated attempt by a European state to check the Barbary corsair state. On the Spanish side stood the Bourbon monarchy of Ferdinand VII, with the army divided between regular troops and provincial militias. The corps sent against Algiers combined the king's own infantry, cavalry and marines, with siege artillery and engineers attached, operating from Cádiz and supplied by sea. The navy contributed a Mediterranean detachment whose flagship was the seventy-four-gun Real Felipe, escorted by a handful of frigates, corvettes and smaller gunboats tasked with blockading the port of Algiers, covering the landings and escorting provisions. The Algerian side was nominally a dependency of the Ottoman Sultan but was in fact ruled independently by the Dey, Hadj Ali, from Algiers. Its defences were built by French engineers working alongside local craftsmen, and its armed force centred on the Turkish odjak regulars and garrison artillery directly under the Dey's command, supplemented by irregular levies drawn from the Berber and Arab tribes and by the crews of the corsair republic's privateers. The other two Barbary regencies, Tunis and Tripoli, nominally stood with the Dey, though their direct contribution of troops was limited. Britain was not formally at war with Spain, yet it intervened through naval blockade, arms supply and diplomacy, and in practice acted as arbiter between the two sides.
people: 德伊哈吉·阿里是這場戰爭的阿爾及爾一方主角。他是奧馬爾·阿加的姪子，前者在圍攻奧蘭期間病死（一八一五年），由他接掌阿爾及爾的統治。他執政初期對歐洲保持戒心，延續前任對法國私掠者的庇護，把阿爾及爾港當作私掠船的母港與庇護所，這一點同時得罪了英國與西班牙。奧蘭的貝伊阿赫梅德·曼蘇爾是阿爾及爾方面的野戰主力，率部在奧蘭與內陸之間作戰，日後成為奧蘭的實際統治者，並在一八一六至一八一七年間與德伊決裂。西班牙總督弗朗西斯科·哈維埃爾·德·埃利奧長期坐鎮奧蘭，主持對阿爾及爾的防守；據西班牙方面的記錄，他早年曾率遠征軍攻阿爾及爾而失利，是最熟悉北非海岸與德伊國地形的人。西班牙國王費迪南德七世在復國之初把收回北非列為優先事項，其軍政大臣與地中海海軍上將共同擬定遠征計畫。英國方面，卡斯特爾雷亞勛爵在外交上主張先以封鎖迫使德伊讓步，再談協議；海軍上將托馬斯·科克倫則力主直接攻取阿爾及爾、摧毀私掠基地。一八一六年，英國海軍上將愛德華·佩盧（埃克斯茅斯勛爵）率分遣隊在直布羅陀海峽擊敗阿爾及爾艦隊，隨後率艦進入阿爾及爾灣，把德伊在港內的私掠船隊打得幾乎全毀，迫使德伊接受英方的條件。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Algerian side was the Dey, Hadj Ali. He was the nephew of Omar Agha, who died of plague while besieging Oran in 1815, and he inherited the government of Algiers. At the start of his rule he kept the Europeans at arm's length, continuing his predecessor's protection of French privateers and treating the harbour of Algiers as a home port and refuge for corsairs — an arrangement that offended both Britain and Spain. Ahmed Bey el-Mansour of Oran was the field commander of the Algerian forces, operating between Oran and the interior; he later became the effective ruler of Oran and broke with the Dey between 1816 and 1817. On the Spanish side, Francisco Javier de Elío held the governorship of Oran for years and directed the defence against Algiers; Spanish records have him leading an earlier Spanish expedition against Algiers that ended in failure, which made him the officer who knew the Algerian coast and the terrain of the Regency better than anyone. King Ferdinand VII made the recovery of North Africa a priority in the first months of the restoration, and his war ministers and the admiral of the Mediterranean detachment together drew up the expedition plan. On the British side, Lord Castlereagh pressed for blockade first and negotiation afterwards, while Admiral Thomas Cochrane argued for seizing Algiers outright and destroying the corsair base. In 1816 Admiral Edward Pellew (Lord Exmouth) destroyed the Algerian squadron in the Strait of Gibraltar and then carried his ships into the Bay of Algiers, reducing the Dey's privateers in the harbour to almost nothing and forcing the Dey to accept British terms.
kits: 火繩槍銃在一八一五年的戰爭裡已經是舊兵器。歐洲野戰主力早已換成燧發滑膛步槍：西班牙遠征軍的步兵主要使用英國在半島戰爭期間供給的燧發槍，亦即一八〇二年型滑膛步槍；阿爾及爾一方則大量採用歐洲式燧發長槍、彎刀與土耳其式火繩長槍。火繩槍銃退到次要位置，但仍真實存在：西班牙的省級民兵、海岸警備與殖民地守備隊伍裡還能找到這類老式長槍，阿爾及爾的非正規民兵與私掠船上的水手也用它守備艙門、登船跳板與貨艙；火繩槍可以長時間保持待發狀態瞄準，緩慢的射速在城牆與船舷的定點射擊中仍有價值。除此之外，戰場上大量出現的是火砲與技術器材：西班牙分遣艦隊自帶野戰砲與攻城砲，攻城時用臼砲對城牆與砲台反覆轟擊，並以數十艘登陸小艇與火攻船試圖突入阿爾及爾港，掩護陸戰隊衝灘；阿爾及爾方面則有沿海岸修築的固定砲台、供小型快速帆船與槳船使用的泊位，以及用來供應城內的沿岸帆船。運輸方面，西班牙靠軍用運輸船隊在加的斯與奧蘭之間運送人員、火砲與糧秣，並以奧蘭為遠征軍的後方基地；阿爾及爾方則依靠驢隊沿海岸與山道輸送補給，軍隊常駐在能俯瞰道路的城堡與營地之中。
kitsEn: By 1815 the arquebus was already obsolete equipment. The European line infantry had long since been re-armed with flintlock smoothbore muskets: the Spanish expedition's infantry mainly carried flintlocks supplied by Britain during the Peninsular War, the 1802 pattern smoothbore musket, while the Algerians used large quantities of European flintlock long guns, scimitars and Turkish matchlock muskets. The arquebus had been pushed into a secondary place, but it was still physically present: older long guns of this type could still be found in the Spanish provincial militias, in coastal watch units and in colonial garrisons, and the Algerian irregular levies and the hands aboard the privateers used them to guard hatches, boarding planks and holds. Because a matchlock can be held at the ready for a long time while the shooter takes aim, its slow rate of fire still had value in fixed-point shooting from ramparts and gunwales. The rest of the material on the field was artillery and technical equipment. The Spanish detachment brought field guns and siege guns with it, hammered the walls and batteries with mortars, and tried to force their way into the harbour of Algiers with dozens of landing boats and fireships so that the marines could reach the shore. The Algerians fielded fixed batteries along the coast, moorings for small lateen-rigged vessels and galleys, and coastal sailing craft used to supply the town. In the way of transport, the Spanish relied on a military transport service to move men, guns and provisions between Cádiz and Oran, with Oran as the base of the expedition; the Algerians moved their supplies by donkey train along the coast road and the mountain tracks, and their troops were quartered in castles and camps that overlooked the routes.
tactics: 西班牙遠征軍的戰法是典型的十八世紀末攻城術：以艦隊封鎖港口切斷德伊的海上貿易，再分批登陸部隊，選擇城東一帶的沙岸與鹽田登灘，在艦砲掩護下建立灘頭堡與圍城砲位，然後步步為營地向城牆推進，把野戰砲與攻城砲一處處拉到射程內射擊。問題是阿爾及爾建在面向海灣的緩坡上，地面高低差大，守軍可以用俯瞰射界的砲台反擊登陸部隊與攻城縱隊；西班牙分遣艦隊一旦遇上逆風就無法保持封鎖，糧秣船隊隨時可能遭阿爾及爾的快速帆船攔截，使圍城變成拉鋸戰。進攻方屢次登陸、屢次受挫之後，轉而用夜間小舟偷渡與側擊堡壘，但守軍在城門與山徑上布哨、退守內城，最終迫使西班牙人退回船上。阿爾及爾一方的戰術則是防守反擊：以海灣砲台與城牆上的排砲控制登陸海灘，在各據點之間以快速帆船與槳船輸送小股部隊，切斷西班牙人的登陸與通信；私掠船隊甚至越過封鎖線進入西班牙沿岸騷擾，用游擊式的襲擊消耗對方的耐心與補給。英國介入之後，海上形勢徹底逆轉：一八一六年四月的海峽海戰裡，阿爾及爾分遣隊排成縱列企圖強行通過海峽，被英軍以縱射與橫向火網截斷；八月英軍進入阿爾及爾灣時，選擇港內私掠船集中泊位的一段先行攻擊，把密集的火力集中在少數目標上，使對方無法疏散。
tacticsEn: The Spanish expedition followed the classic late-eighteenth-century practice of siege: the fleet blockaded the port to cut the Dey's maritime trade, troops landed in echelons, chose the sandy beaches east of the town and the salt pans for their landings, established a beachhead and siege battery positions under cover of the ships' guns, and then advanced by dug-in bounds, dragging field and siege guns into range one position at a time. The difficulty was that Algiers was built on a slope facing the bay: the differences in ground level were great, and the garrison could bring its batteries to bear with plunging fire on the landing craft and the siege columns. Whenever the wind rose against them the Spanish squadron could not maintain the blockade, and the provision ships could be intercepted at any moment by Algerian lateen-rigged cruisers, turning the siege into a war of attrition. After repeated failures to storm the town, the attackers resorted to night landings in small boats and flanking attacks on the redoubts, but sentries on the gates and mountain paths, and the withdrawal into the inner town, finally forced the Spaniards back aboard. The Algerian method was defence and counter-stroke: batteries along the bay and rows of guns on the walls commanded the landing beaches, small detachments were shifted between positions in fast sailing craft and galleys to sever the Spaniards' landings and communications, and the privateers even slipped through the blockade line to harry the Spanish coast, wearing down the enemy's patience and supplies with hit-and-run raids. Once Britain entered, the situation at sea inverted completely. In the battle in the Strait of Gibraltar in April 1816 the Algerian detachment, formed in line ahead in an attempt to force its way through the strait, was cut by British broadside and cross-fire; when the British entered the Bay of Algiers in August, they attacked first that stretch of the anchorage where the privateers lay concentrated, concentrating overwhelming fire on a few targets so that the enemy could not scatter.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，以下幾項大致可以確定：遠征艦隊的旗艦「皇家菲利普號」為七十四門砲的戰列艦，除旗艦外還有數艘巡防艦、護衛艦與砲艦隨行；登陸的遠征軍規模在五千人上下，各種說法略有出入，實際作戰的營數遠少於編制數。一八一六年四月五日的直布羅陀海峽海戰，英軍分遣隊出動十餘艘，敵方出動的護衛艦與快速帆船約十艘。一八一六年八月二十七日英軍在阿爾及爾灣的攻擊中，港內停泊的阿爾及爾私掠船有數十艘被擊毀或重創，據英方報告，餘下的船隻不足出動總數的一半，這是德伊的私掠船隊在十九世紀遭受的最重一次打擊。西班牙在戰後仍保有奧蘭與梅爾斯埃爾凱比爾兩處據點；阿爾及爾城在戰前的居民約五萬人上下，城市沿著海灣的坡地層層鋪開，防禦縱深有限但居高臨下。戰爭自一八一五年春開打到一八一六年下半年，前後約一年半，遠征軍的人員與攻城器材多數沒有回國，損失集中在攻城砲與登陸作戰的傷亡。
dataEn: Few hard figures survive, but the following can be treated as roughly established. The flagship of the expeditionary squadron, the Real Felipe, was a seventy-four-gun ship of the line, accompanied by a small number of frigates, corvettes and gunboats. The landing force numbered on the order of five thousand men — the accounts differ, and the number of battalions that actually fought was well below the establishment. In the battle in the Strait of Gibraltar on 5 April 1816 the British detachment brought out more than ten ships against roughly ten Algerian frigates and fast sailing craft. In the British attack in the Bay of Algiers on 27 August 1816, dozens of Algerian privateers lying in the anchorage were destroyed or left crippled; by the British report, fewer than half of the ships that had been present survived in seaworthy condition, and this was the heaviest blow the Dey's corsair fleet took in the nineteenth century. After the war Spain still held the two presidios of Oran and Mers el-Kébir. The population of the town of Algiers before the war was on the order of fifty thousand, spread in tiers up the slope of the bay, which gave the defences a shallow depth but a commanding view. The war ran from the spring of 1815 to the second half of 1816, about a year and a half, and most of the expedition's guns and equipment never came home, the losses falling on the siege artillery and on the casualties of the landings.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因是拿破崙戰爭的收場把歐洲秩序重新洗牌，然後新秩序立刻要向巴巴利世界討債。西班牙在拿破崙戰爭中被迫放棄北非的海外據點，一八一四年波旁王室復辟後，費迪南德七世要收回奧蘭、梅爾斯埃爾凱比爾以及阿爾及爾城內那座西班牙據城，這是王室的威望問題，也是馬德魯斯的航運利益問題——西班牙商船在海峽與地中海西岸屢遭私掠船襲擊，被擄去的船員又淪為奴隸。德伊哈吉·阿里則有自己的算盤：阿爾及爾的財政與海軍實力靠私掠船隊維持，把法國餘下的私掠者留在港內，等於留住一批熟手、也留住一份收入；德伊向基督徒商船徵收貨物關稅並扣留其貨物，雙方在商路與稅權上的衝突因此越積越深。英國的介入則讓天平更傾斜：英國要求德伊交出寄泊的法國私掠船、廢除奴役基督徒的做法，否則不予承認，雙方在談判破裂後走向戰爭。西班牙選在一八一五年春開火，正是等拿破崙在歐洲的最後一場戰役結束、法國秩序崩解、阿爾及爾孤立無援的窗口。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was the end of the Napoleonic struggle reshuffling the European order, after which the new order immediately called in its debts from the Barbary world. Spain had been forced to give up its North African positions during the Napoleonic wars, and after the Bourbon restoration in 1814 Ferdinand VII intended to recover Oran, Mers el-Kébir and the Spanish presidio inside Algiers — a matter of royal prestige, and also of commercial interest, because Spanish merchant shipping in the strait and on the western Mediterranean was repeatedly attacked by corsairs whose crews were carried off into slavery. The Dey, Hadj Ali, had his own calculations: the finances and the naval strength of Algiers rested on the privateer fleet, and keeping the remaining French corsairs in harbour meant keeping a pool of skilled hands and a source of income; the Dey taxed the goods of Christian merchants and detained their cargoes, so that the conflict over trade routes and tax rights kept deepening on both sides. British involvement tipped the balance further: London demanded that the Dey hand over the French privateers sheltering in the port and abandon the enslavement of Christians, and refused to recognise him otherwise; when the talks broke down, both sides moved towards war. Spain chose to open hostilities in the spring of 1815 precisely because the last campaign of the Napoleonic wars in Europe was over, the French order had collapsed, and Algiers stood isolated.
impact: 對西班牙來說，這是一場代價高而收穫薄的戰爭：阿爾及爾沒有打下來，奧蘭與梅爾斯埃爾凱比爾只是守住了原有位置，而遠征軍耗掉的火炮、軍費與人命都沒有換來新的據點。西班牙此後在北非只剩兩個直屬的據點與有限的駐軍，一八三〇年法軍登陸阿爾及爾、西班牙無法出兵干涉的結局，多多少少可以回溯到這幾年實力的耗散。對巴巴利世界而言，一八一六年是轉折：私掠船隊在阿爾及爾灣被英軍重創，歐洲各國在同一時期合力切斷私掠船的補給與銷贓港口，巴巴利海軍從此不再能以國家力量威脅地中海航運，德伊的財政也失去一大支柱，私掠逐漸由國家軍事業轉為個人冒險，海軍重建要拖到一八二〇年代。奴隸貿易方面，英國與西班牙先後要求德伊廢除奴役基督徒，歐洲基督徒被擄為奴的案例大減，但對非洲黑奴的買賣並未因此停止，德伊國的奴隸市場轉向別的來源，問題被推遲而沒有消失。技術層面上，這場戰爭也確認了一件事：火繩槍銃在歐洲戰場上已經退場，野戰的標準是燧發滑膛步槍加上野戰砲，火繩槍銃只剩下民兵、海岸警備與私掠船上的次要位置。
impactEn: For Spain this was an expensive war with thin returns: Algiers was not taken, Oran and Mers el-Kébir were merely held where they already stood, and the guns, money and lives the expedition consumed bought no new position. Spain was left in North Africa with two directly administered presidios and a small garrison, and when French troops landed at Algiers in 1830 and Spain could not send a single soldier to intervene, part of that outcome can be traced back to the drain on the country's strength over these years. For the Barbary world, 1816 was a turning point. The privateer fleet was mauled in the Bay of Algiers, and at the same time the European powers combined to cut the privateers off from supplies and from the ports where they sold their prizes; the Barbary navy could no longer threaten Mediterranean shipping with the weight of a state, and the Dey lost a main prop of his revenue, privateering turning from a state undertaking into individual venture, with the navy not rebuilt until the 1820s. On the slave trade, Britain and Spain in turn required the Dey to abandon the enslavement of Christians, and the number of Christians taken into slavery fell sharply, but the trade in enslaved Africans was not thereby ended: the Regency's slave markets simply turned to other sources, and the problem was postponed rather than solved. On the technical level the war confirmed one thing: the arquebus had left the European battlefield, the standard for field war being the flintlock smoothbore musket backed by field artillery, and the arquebus surviving only in a secondary place on the hands of militias, coastal watch and privateers.
result: 打到一八一六年下半年，西班牙與德伊之間達成協議，西班牙沒有取回阿爾及爾的據城，也沒有其他新的收穫，但保住了奧蘭與梅爾斯埃爾凱比爾，承認德伊對阿爾及爾與其他海灣據點的統治；德伊方面則承諾不再奴役基督徒、釋放被扣的俘虜，並允許西班牙商人以與其他歐洲商人相同的條件在阿爾及爾通商，廢除先前加在歐洲貨物上的那筆被昵稱為「葡萄糖」的稅與扣貨行為——西班牙語史料因此把這場戰爭叫作「葡萄糖之戰」。同一時期，英國用海峽海戰與阿爾及爾灣的砲擊把德伊的私掠艦隊打殘，迫使他以賠款和釋放俘虜了事，德伊的政權在接下來的十年裡再沒有受過大規模的海上打擊，阿爾及爾的重建與重新武裝反而在此後緩慢恢復。對武器史而言，這場戰爭留下的是一個明確的斷點：火繩槍銃仍留在守備隊與私掠船上，但野戰的決定性武器已經換成燧發步槍與野戰砲，火繩槍銃退成軍械庫裡的舊物與儀式性的裝備。
resultEn: By the second half of 1816 Spain and the Dey had come to terms. Spain did not recover the presidio at Algiers and gained nothing new, but kept Oran and Mers el-Kébir and recognised the Dey's rule over Algiers and the other coastal possessions; the Dey in turn undertook not to enslave Christians, to release the captives he held, and to admit Spanish merchants to trade at Algiers on the same terms as other European traders, with the tax and seizures previously laid on European goods — the levy nicknamed the 'glucose' — abolished. Spanish-language sources accordingly call the war the War of the Glucose. At the same time Britain, through the battle in the strait and the bombardment of the Bay of Algiers, wrecked the Dey's corsair squadron and forced him to settle the account with an indemnity and the release of prisoners, and the regency was not to suffer another large-scale blow at sea for the decade that followed, the rebuilding and rearming of Algiers proceeding slowly in its place. For the history of weapons the war leaves a clear break: the arquebus remained in the hands of garrisons and privateers, but the decisive weapon of field combat had passed to the flintlock musket and the field gun, and the arquebus sank to the status of an old piece in the armoury and a ceremonial item.
